notes: Interest-paid is now attributed newest-loan-first (LIFO), so interest collected settles the current loan and old loans' unpaid interest stays visible. Fix: a seller/buyer with a live loan whose history includes voided legacy loans no longer shows 'no active loans' — the loan ledger now reads a loan's closed/void status from its own advance and computes balances from live rows only (e.g. Chinnasamy.P.S's HL1976 ₹7,000 now shows as active) (VCA317).
